question: How do I book Oscar?
answer: Use the website contact calendar. A 30-minute Google Meet consultation costs S/20 PEN, paid using MercadoPago. Only the approved-payment webhook confirms the event. Office hours are Monday–Friday 09:00–13:00 and 14:00–17:00 America/Lima.

es.answer: Usa el calendario de Contacto de la web. La consulta de 30 minutos por Google Meet cuesta S/20 PEN y se paga con MercadoPago. Solo el webhook de pago aprobado confirma el evento. Horario: lunes a viernes, 09:00–13:00 y 14:00–17:00, America/Lima.

question: Can I ask technical questions without sharing contact information?
answer: Yes. Questions about software, cloud, data, AI and project planning do not require personal details. Consent is requested only when saving personal information or sending/uploading material.

es.answer: Sí. Las preguntas de software, nube, datos, IA y planificación no requieren datos personales. El consentimiento se pide al guardar datos personales o enviar/subir material.

en.answer: Yes. Questions about software, cloud, data, AI and project planning do not require personal details. Consent is requested only when saving personal information or sending/uploading material.

question: Are starting prices final quotes?
answer: No. The verified catalog provides reference starting prices. Final scope, integrations, timelines, third-party costs and maintenance need agreement with Oscar.

es.answer: No. El catálogo ofrece precios de referencia desde. El alcance final, integraciones, plazos, servicios externos y mantenimiento deben acordarse con Oscar.

en.answer: No. The verified catalog provides reference starting prices. Final scope, integrations, timelines, third-party costs and maintenance need agreement with Oscar.

question: What if a date, employer detail or credential is missing?
answer: Do not infer it. State that the detail is unverified and offer the LinkedIn source or a meeting.

es.answer: No se infiere. El dato se identifica como no verificado y se ofrece consultar LinkedIn o una reunión.

en.answer: Do not infer it. State that the detail is unverified and offer the LinkedIn source or a meeting.
